name: Republic of India

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 2,973,190 km2 (World Bank AG.LND.TOTL.K2); high adds ~3% for inland water.

population.note: asOf 2025: 1,463,865,525 (World Bank). Range allows for 2026 change.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2026 p.260 as quoted: 1,500,700 active. CIA Factbook 2025 ~1.5 million (Army ~1.25 million). Paramilitary (2,532,050 incl. CAPF, Assam Rifles) excluded.

trainedReserves.note: IISS Military Balance 2026: 1,155,000 reserves (Army 960,000-class Territorial Army and ex-servicemen liability). High allows for Territorial Army expansion.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 1,500,700 minus infantry P roles 500,000 = 1,000,700. Air Force (~149,000 per IISS 2025 on the IAF article), Navy (~74,000), armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics and staff.

mobilizationRatio.note: Educated guess. India has no conscription and the binding constraint is equipment and training cadres; 2% is still ~29 million people. WWII British India raised ~2.5 million volunteers from ~390 million (0.6%).

morale.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: motivated, recent claimed success against Pakistan (May 2025); home defence on two contested borders.

weapons.note: Anchor 9-10: BrahMos, Agni-V, precision munitions (SCALP, Hammer), large but older artillery park.

armor.note: Anchor 9 composite armour (T-90S, Arjun) with many T-72M1 (anchor 8-9).

ships.note: Anchor 9-10: two carriers, Kolkata/Visakhapatnam destroyers, SSBNs; no SSN in service.

fortification.note: Anchor 9: hardened shelters, layered air defence (S-400, MR-SAM) around key bases; LAC infrastructure building.

logistics.note: Anchor 9: rail-centred, limited strategic airlift (C-17 11, Il-76 17).

communications.note: Anchor 9: GSAT-7/7A military satellites, data links; network-centric integration incomplete.

isr.note: Anchor 9-10: RISAT/Cartosat satellites, Netra AEW&C, P-8I; MALE fleet small.

air.note: Anchor 9 (4.5 generation Rafale, Su-30MKI); no 5th-generation aircraft (AMCA in development).

cyber.note: Anchor 9-10: Defence Cyber Agency (2019), state-linked operations reported.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP (2011 int$) 11,764,027,749,252 / population 1,463,865,525 = 8,036. Range +/-15%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 14,695,849,780,452 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 11,764,027,749,252 2011 int$. Range +/-15% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/IND/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD?format=json Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Net food exporter (rice, wheat, sugar) with large buffer stocks; per-capita intake still low.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 754,775,449 x share of males aged 15-19 8.793% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 13,273,970. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Rail-based mechanised logistics on the western front; high-altitude LAC supply is road/air limited.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules, ponies, donkeys (not from FAO data); Army still keeps mule/pony units for mountain logistics.

nuclearWarheads.note: FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026: military stockpile 190 (178 reserve/non-deployed as tabulated). Range +/-10.

basesAbroad.name: Agalega Island airstrip and jetty (Mauritius, Indian-built)

chokepoints: Line of Actual Control passes (Ladakh, Arunachal)

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: fortified cities, population support; 1.3 for high-altitude Himalayan fronts (harsh climate, altitude).

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with a 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:IND (World Bank), i.e. India-administered Kashmir included, Pakistan/China-administered parts excluded. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Equipment counts from Wikipedia equipment/aircraft lists that quote IISS Military Balance 2023-2024 for many lines; others are national or press figures (grade C). India fought a short air/missile conflict with Pakistan in May 2025 (Operation Sindoor); losses are disputed and not modelled. ships_major = carriers + destroyers + frigates; ships_minor = corvettes, OPV, amphibious, MCM, large patrol; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits, missiles and air_defense batteries are educated guesses (grade D). Paramilitary (CAPF, Assam Rifles, Coast Guard; IISS 2,532,050) excluded. Cross-check: Global Firepower ranks India 4th (not used as a source).
